full_page.content:
1946, September 23
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God Father Sclaons Comey . O. F.M. Cap.
O all ye work of the Lord! Bless the Lord!
September 23rd, 1946
God bless you Mrs. B. M. Schumacher - you and yours.
Many thanks for your appreciated favor of August 24th. I have enrolled the Poor Souls specially for your intentions and mine. I am confident they will help us out of many troubles that would otherwise come to us. Thank you for your kind prayers. That is something all need very much.
Thanks be to God for all things.
Sincerely yours in Christ,
Fr. Solanus, O. F.M.Cap.
Original in possession of: Bernice M. Schumacher 42079 Toddmark Lane Mt. Clemens, Michigan48044
